Chapter 1010: Chapter 21 Lucky Human Civilization (Please Subscribe)

When Lin Yuan mastered the first layer of “Infinite Void,” his body universe rivaled the body universe of the Chaos Venerable.

The Origin Source consciousness of the Main Universe was already unable to do anything to him.

In terms of magnitude, Lin Yuan’s body universe was equivalent to the Cosmic Starry Skies of the Main Universe.

This meant that even if the Origin Source consciousness of the Main Universe threw all caution to the wind, it could, at most, barely trap Lin Yuan.

When the Great Universe Cataclysm arrived and the Origin Source consciousness weakened, it couldn’t even hope to restrain Lin Yuan.

“Galaxy Supreme, what you said…”

The nine supreme beings of human civilization, including Xuanyuan Supreme, were all stunned and horrified.

The Origin Source consciousness of the universe? Incapable of dealing with Lin Yuan?

Ordinary lifeforms cannot perceive the Origin Source consciousness of the universe; even beings of the Eleventh Layer can barely sense its power.

But beings at the Twelfth Layer ultimate level? While they have escaped the bindings of the River of Time, they also directly face the Origin Source consciousness. They fully understand what kind of entity it truly is.

The Origin Source consciousness of the universe is the aggregate of all the universe’s forces. With a single thought, it can harness all the universe’s power, and its unleashed might within the cosmos can reach the Chaos Realm.

Typical Twelfth Layer Path Splitting Realm beings wouldn’t dare to oppose the Origin Source consciousness. Even the two ultimate beings of the Robber Clan are the same in this regard, as the gap between them and the consciousness is too vast to bridge.

The only silver lining is that the Origin Source consciousness is a kind of diffuse awareness, merely instinctive. Otherwise, all living beings under its domain, including Twelfth Layer ultimate beings, would be enslaved by it.

The nine supreme beings of human civilization exchanged glances, hesitant to speak.

They had immense trust in Lin Yuan, but making the Origin Source consciousness powerless within the universe? That was utterly beyond their comprehension.

“A breakthrough.” Lin Yuan smiled faintly, understanding the confusion of Xuanyuan and Xia Qin Supreme, raising his hand casually to tear apart a vast portion of the void.

Compared to the first time when Lin Yuan unleashed power surpassing the peak of the Path Splitting Realm, the consciousness of the Origin Source had descended for a glance.

This time, the Origin Source consciousness didn’t even bother to descend.

“This…?”

The nine supreme beings of human civilization were shocked. A casual strike from Lin Yuan carried overwhelming power that, under normal circumstances, would surely attract the attention of the Origin Source consciousness. Yet, none of the supreme beings present detected even a ripple from the Origin Source consciousness.

Deep in their hearts, the nine supreme beings began to form a faint realization.

And that was—

The Origin Source consciousness of the universe was intimidated by Lin Yuan.

“Galaxy Supreme, compared to you, we nine…”

The Ancient Power Supreme looked at Lin Yuan with a complicated expression, filled with emotion.

They had watched Lin Yuan grow step by step from an exceedingly weak lifeform to now becoming a great existence capable of contending against the Origin Source consciousness of the universe.

Unlike Lin Yuan, the strength of the nine supreme beings had barely changed since they first began paying attention to him.

“With the Galaxy Supreme among us, how fortunate is human civilization….”

Xuanyuan Supreme sighed deeply. Because of Lin Yuan, the trajectory of the cosmos had shifted, leaving human civilization in a dominant position.

And now, as the Universe Cataclysm approached, Lin Yuan once again ensured that human civilization wouldn’t have to endure the agony of parting with loved ones.

Human civilization has benefited tremendously from Lin Yuan. In reviewing past Universe Cataclysms, which species hadn’t sacrificed 99% of their population?

Some selfish Twelfth Layer beings had even abandoned their entire species to increase their own survival chances in the face of the Universe Cataclysm.

…

“If we are to relocate all human civilization citizens, then the migration plan for the species must be completely revised.” Feather Butterfly Supreme immediately started considering a new migration strategy.

“We only need to move all citizens into this area.” A map floated in front of Lin Yuan as he pointed to a specific region.

This region spanned roughly 20 million light-years, large enough to accommodate all citizens of human civilization.

“All concentrated in this area?” Xia Qin Supreme looked at Lin Yuan.

“I have the ability to relocate all citizens within this region to my body universe in one go.”

Lin Yuan said.

Now, the scope of his body universe extended to 20 million light-years. By employing the Divine Ability ‘World,’ he could instantly form an external universe spanning 20 million light-years.

Although there was a time limit, it was more than sufficient to transfer all human civilization citizens into his body universe.

Once all human civilization citizens entered the body universe, Lin Yuan would be confident in anchoring every citizen as a reference point and transferring their life essence imprint from the River of Time of the Cosmic Starry Skies into the River of Time within his body universe.

“That’s quite simple.”

Xuanyuan Supreme nodded.

In fact, if all human civilization citizens could be relocated, it would simplify matters significantly.

Under the original extraction method, citizens selected for relocation would inevitably have to bid farewell to family and friends, wasting a huge amount of time.

Some citizens, while saying their goodbyes, might even give up their relocation opportunity, forcing the process to start over—a cumbersome affair.

The three goddesses and supreme beings had seen these scenarios unfold and knew there was no way to rush such matters.

But now?

If all citizens could be relocated, there would be no need for farewells or separations. Human civilization could fully mobilize its powerful evolutionary beings to relocate one planet at a time.

This would greatly enhance efficiency.

After roughly finalizing their discussions, the nine supreme beings felt a deep sense of relief.

According to the initial migration plan they had drafted, the immense pressure came from the need to abandon 90% of human civilization citizens.
